info.title: tenant-user-service
info.description: Implemented identity HTTP API. Session cookies, not bearer JWTs. Identity routes are not currently forwarded by campus-api-gateway. Mutation requests require the exact AUTH_ORIGIN, X-Campus-Request: 1 and application/json. No student/teacher resource APIs are exposed here. Default body limit is 16 KiB. HEAD mirrors GET; framework CORS preflight OPTIONS is handled automatically, not a business operation. A separate optional TLS-only internal listener implements session introspection; it is never registered on the public listener. OpenAPI 3.0 cannot express client-certificate security: x-mtls-required and the operation description specify the mandatory transport authentication.

post.description: Private listener only. Mandatory TLS 1.3 with a trusted client certificate containing exact URI SAN spiffe://campus/campus-core-api; no HTTP header substitutes for the certificate. Only core.school-profile.read.v1 / school.read is supported. Check every request online; no cache/retry/redirect. Read-only profile requires null csrfToken/origin. Decisions expire within 5 seconds and session expiry; they are usable only for the matching outstanding request. Database failures return 503, not inactive. Unsupported profiles return 403. Public listener returns 404. The empty standard security array reflects the OpenAPI 3.0 mTLS limitation, NOT anonymous access.
